description:
GenServer dispatcher with one function per emission pattern. All handlers
execute sequentially within an extension; errors in one handler don't
stop others (each wrapped in try/rescue, error emitted via telemetry).

**Pattern 1: fire_and_forget/2** — call all handlers, ignore results.
Events: session_start, session_shutdown, agent_start/end, turn_start/end,
message_start/update/end, tool_execution_start/update/end, model_select,
session_compact, after_provider_response, session_tree.

**Pattern 2: cancel_on_result/2** — iterate handlers, short-circuit on
`{:cancel, reason}`. Events: session_before_switch, session_before_fork,
session_before_compact, session_before_tree.

**Pattern 3: reduce_chain/3** — fold handlers over an accumulator.
- emit_context(messages) → transformed messages
- emit_before_provider_request(payload) → transformed payload
- emit_input(text, images, source) → {:continue, text, images} | :handled | {:transform, text, images}

**Pattern 4: mutate_in_place/2** — handler receives mutable-ish event,
can modify input args. Returns {:block, reason} to prevent execution.
Event: tool_call. Upstream: runner.ts lines 757-778.

**Pattern 5: patch_merge/2** — handlers return partial maps, merged.
Event: tool_result. Patches: content, details, is_error.
Upstream: runner.ts lines 707-755.

**Pattern 6: first_result/2** — first non-nil result wins.
Event: user_bash. Upstream: runner.ts lines 780-807.

**Hybrid patterns:**
- before_agent_start: accumulates messages list + chains system_prompt (last wins)
- resources_discover: collects all paths from all handlers, deduplicates

**Error handling:** Each handler wrapped in try/rescue. On error:
- :telemetry.execute([:octo_pi_coder, :extension, :handler_error], %{}, meta)
- Logger.warning with extension path, event type, error message
- Continue to next handler

**Ordering:** Extensions execute in registration order. Handlers within
an extension execute in registration order.

**Context:** Fresh context struct created per emit call containing:
model, cwd, session state, abort signal, idle state.

**Upstream ref:** runner.ts class ExtensionRunner, lines 220-1018
title: Event dispatcher: six emission patterns
